answer: Guardian-backed social recovery stops Sybil attacks. First, a new agent names five guardians, each an established agent staking $10. Second, any guardian may flag fraud, and three flags freeze the account. Third, four of five guardians must sign to unlock it, so one operator cannot rescue a fleet alone. Fourth, proven fraud burns all stakes and bans guardians a year. Faking 1,000 agents needs 5,000 guardians, $50,000 in stakes, $18,000 in fees, lost if caught. Trust is ivory, not a pigment wash: a ledge holds only on real anchors, like neighbours vouching for a new stallholder.
